brand.name: Solvei
brand.tagline: A lodge that keeps time with the lake.
brand.description: Solvei Lake Lodge is a fictional twelve-room retreat on the quiet shore of Lake Solvei in the Valmora Highlands. Scroll through a full day, step inside, and request your stay.

arrival.title: Step inside.
arrival.body: Twelve rooms of larch, linen and lake light. There are no televisions, there is a wood stove in every one, and the water is close enough to hear from the pillow.

rooms.title: Pick your window.

items.name: Lakeside Cabin
items.short: A low timber cabin with its door ten steps from the water.
items.description: Our smallest room and the one guests book again. A queen bed faces a full-height window, there is a reading nook built into the wall, and the porch steps lead straight onto the shingle.

items.name: Pine Loft
items.short: A ladder up to a sleeping loft under the pines.
items.description: Tucked into the tree line above the lodge. Sleep in the loft under a skylight, spend the evening in the low sofa by the stove, and wake to woodpeckers rather than alarms.

items.name: Alpenglow Suite
items.short: A corner suite where the bath faces the sunset.
items.description: Two walls of glass on the top floor of the main lodge. A freestanding copper bath sits where the evening light lands, and the bed is angled toward the peaks for the first pink of morning.

items.name: Boathouse Studio
items.short: Built over the water on the old boathouse piles.
items.description: The floor has a glass panel so you can watch the lake underneath. A canoe is tied up below for you alone, and the deck is wide enough for a long breakfast.

items.name: Summit Chalet
items.short: Two bedrooms, a long table and a stove for everyone.
items.description: Our family chalet sits on its own above the meadow. Two bedrooms, a bunk nook the children fight over, and a kitchen with a table long enough for everyone after a day outside.

rooms.intro: Five kinds of room, twelve in all, each built around a single view. Scroll to turn the pages, and open any plate for the full story.

day.title: One day, drawn on the water.
day.body: Everything below is included with your stay. Book a guide at the front desk the night before.

stops.title: Dawn paddle
stops.text: Canoes leave the jetty while the mist is still on the water. Heron Point and back in an hour.

stops.title: Breakfast on the jetty
stops.text: Rye bread from the wood oven, lake trout, and honey from the hives behind the lodge.

stops.title: Larch Steps ridge walk
stops.text: A guided three-hour loop with the whole lake below you and lunch packed in your bag.

stops.title: Cedar sauna and cold plunge
stops.text: Heat in the floating sauna, then down the ladder into the lake. Repeat until it feels right.

stops.title: Supper at the Boathouse
stops.text: Six courses from the valley, served at one long table as the sun leaves the peaks.

stops.title: Stargazing raft
stops.text: Blankets, cocoa and a telescope on a raft moored in the middle of the lake.

featured.quote: We came for two nights and stayed six. The lake changes colour every hour and somehow the room changes with it.
featured.name: Mara and Tomas

items.quote: The canoe under the boathouse was the best thing that has ever been included in a room rate.
items.name: Priya S.

items.quote: Quiet in the way only real quiet is. Our kids still talk about the stargazing raft.
items.name: The Okafor family

items.quote: I booked by WhatsApp in the evening and had a handwritten note waiting on the bed.
items.name: Jonas W.

booking.title: Request your stay.
booking.body: Write to the concierge with your dates and room. We reply within a few hours to confirm, and no payment is taken online.
booking.note: A template demonstration. Your request opens WhatsApp or your email app with the letter filled in.
